subject: generateGateProof HMACs with FLAG_SECRET, a per-INSTANCE crypto.randomBytes(32) that is never persisted - same multi-instance/cold-start instability class as the tournament flag work; surfaced by Nancy during the QA-02 design review, not yet measured
description:
functions/index.js:41 - const FLAG_SECRET = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex') at MODULE SCOPE, so every Cloud Function instance holds a DIFFERENT secret and every cold start mints a new one. functions/index.js:2803-2811 generateGateProof HMACs with it.

Consequence to MEASURE before assuming it is a defect: if a proof minted by instance A is later verified by instance B, or after a cold start, verification fails for a legitimate caller. If minting and verifying always happen inside one request, it is harmless by construction. Nobody has checked which.

Surfaced 2026-09-17 by the adversarial reviewer while confirming that FLAG_SECRET is unusable as a stable HMAC key for the tournament flag fix (taskboard 401) - which it is, for exactly this reason. Filed so the same fact is not rediscovered later as a fresh P0 in the gate-proof path.

NOT a blocker for 401: the tournament fix moves flag crypto out of client reach entirely and does not adopt FLAG_SECRET.
